canDoYue: 你識話要寄包裹、填表申報，仲識問幾多日同追蹤編號。
canDoEn: Send a parcel, fill in the form, and ask about days and tracking.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I would like to send this small parcel by airmail to Macau.
dialogue.glossYue: 我想用空郵寄呢個細包裹去澳門。
dialogue.say: I would like to send this small parcel by airmail to Macau.

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.text: How long will this heavy parcel take to reach that destination?
dialogue.glossYue: 呢個重包裹去到目的地要幾耐？
dialogue.say: How long will this heavy parcel take to reach that destination?

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.text: Please fill in the full customs form and then declare every item.
dialogue.glossYue: 請填完整張海關表格，然後逐項申報。
dialogue.say: Please fill in the full customs form and then declare every item.

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.text: This parcel is fragile, so please mark the full weight clearly.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢個包裹易碎，請清楚標明全部重量。
dialogue.say: This parcel is fragile, so please mark the full weight clearly.

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.text: Your tracking number is printed clearly on this paper receipt.
dialogue.glossYue: 你嘅追蹤號碼清楚印喺呢張收據上面。
dialogue.say: Your tracking number is printed clearly on this paper receipt.

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.text: It will take five days, and we need your signature here.
dialogue.glossYue: 要五日，我哋需要你喺呢度簽名。
dialogue.say: It will take five days, and we need your signature here.

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.text: Please put one stamp on the parcel before we send it out.
dialogue.glossYue: 寄出之前請喺包裹上面貼一張郵票。
dialogue.say: Please put one stamp on the parcel before we send it out.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Please keep this receipt until the parcel reaches your home safely.
dialogue.glossYue: 請保存呢張收據，直到包裹安全送到你屋企。
dialogue.say: Please keep this receipt until the parcel reaches your home safely.

understand.prompt: I would like to send this small parcel by airmail to Macau. 呢句即係點？
choices: 我想空郵寄細包裹去澳門
understand.explain: parcel 係包裹。airmail 係空郵。

understand.prompt: How long will this heavy parcel take to reach that destination? 即係問緊咩？
understand.explain: how long 係問要幾耐。destination 係目的地。

understand.prompt: Your tracking number is printed clearly on this paper receipt. 呢句即係點？
understand.explain: tracking number 係追蹤編號。receipt 係收據。

sound.title: weight 同 stamp
sound.note: weight 同 airmail 嘅 mail 有 /eɪ/。stamp 同 fragile 有 /æ/，嘴張大。兩個都唔好讀成粵語嘅「衣」。
